panel.panel_overview:
### Leveling Management Panel
Manage all your server's leveling settings from one place.

**📊 XP Settings**
{xp_state} XP enabled  •  Multiplier: `{multiplier}x`  •  Cooldown: `{cooldown}s`

**📡 Channels & Voice**
Channels excluded from XP: `{excluded}`  •  Voice XP: {voice_state}
-# Ticket channels never award XP.

**📣 Announcements**
Level-up channel: {levelup_channel}
Custom message: {custom_message}

**🎖️ Level Roles** *(automatically awarded on level-up)*
{roles}

**🎨 Card Style**
Accent colour: `{accent}`

-# Use the dropdown below to navigate and configure each section.
panel.panel_xp:
### 📊 XP Settings
Control how members earn experience in your server.

{state} — **XP Tracking**

**XP Multiplier:** `{multiplier}x`
Each message earns `15–25 × multiplier` XP at random.

**XP Cooldown:** {cooldown}
Minimum time between XP gains per member (0 = every message).

-# Use **Channels & Voice** to exclude channels from XP or enable passive voice XP.
panel.panel_channels:
### 📡 Channels & Voice
Control where members can earn XP.

**Excluded Channels**
{excluded}
-# Messages and time spent in these channels never award XP.
-# Ticket channels are always excluded automatically.

**Voice XP:** {voice}
-# When enabled, members earn XP for every minute they spend in a voice channel. AFK channels never award XP.

-# Use the selector below to change the excluded channels.
panel.panel_announcements:
### 📣 Announcement Settings
Configure where and how level-ups are announced.

**Level-Up Channel:** {channel}
-# Select a channel below or clear it to announce in the message's channel.

**Level-Up Message:**
> {message}

-# Available placeholders: `{mention}` `{level}` `{name}` `{guild}`
-# Click **Edit Message** to customise, or **Reset Message** to restore the default.
panel.panel_roles:
### 🎖️ Level Roles
Roles automatically awarded when a member reaches a certain level.

{roles}

-# Click **{plus} Add Role** to assign a role to a level.
-# Click **➖ Remove Role** to remove an assignment.
panel.panel_cardstyle:
### 🎨 Card Style
Customise the colours used in level cards and the leaderboard.

**Accent Colour:** `{accent}`
Used for borders, level numbers, and the progress bar.

**Background Top:** `{bg_top}`
**Background Bottom:** `{bg_bottom}`
The gradient fills the card background.

-# Use the buttons below to edit each colour.
-# Enter hex codes like `#d96545` or `ff5500`.
-# Click **Reset Colours** to restore the default colours.
